name:
Pokémon™ Omega Ruby:
Update
description:
An update for Pokémon™ Omega Ruby is now available from Nintendo eShop.

This will update the software to Version 1.4 with the following amendments:

- Various bugs have been fixed in order to provide a smoother gaming experience.

Once the update has been downloaded, it will be installed automatically.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused, and recommend downloading this update to ensure a smooth game experience.

Please note that Pokémon™ Alpha Sapphire cannot be updated using this data and you have to download the update data for Pokémon™ Alpha Sapphire separately.
disclaimer:
You may need to upgrade your current SD Card to a compatible SDHC Card or microSDHC Card with enough available space to download this software.
Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.
